effects.description: (2 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) While in combat, using an ability with a range of 7 meters or less grants you Range Supremacy for |cffffff5|r seconds, adding |cffffff10-437|r Weapon and Spell Damage to your damage over time and ranged attacks. 

While in combat, using an ability with a range of over 7 meters grants you Melee Supremacy for |cffffff5|r seconds, adding |cffffff10-437|r Weapon and Spell Damage to your melee attacks.
